common.title: Frontier Access Denied
common.line: The Union is cut off from the leading model at short notice, wholly or by nationality of user.

notable.title: Graduate protest wave
notable.line: Coordinated graduate-led protests across several EU capitals target empty Entry-Level Transition Guarantee offices and data-centre sites, merging job anxiety with anti-AI sentiment and forcing a policing and funding response.

notable.title: Uncertified backlash boycott
notable.line: Uncertified municipal utilities and clinics hit by automated intrusions publicly blame the EU certificate scheme for leaving them exposed, triggering coordinated refusal to share incident telemetry.
